body.heading: Stamp a row
paragraphs: Your adult cuts the sponge into a square, a triangle, and a circle. Dip one in paint and press it on the paper.
Stamp it again and again in a row. Keep the spaces between stamps as even as you can.

body.heading: Mix the pattern
paragraphs: Try a rhythm: circle, square, circle, square. Then invent your own rhythm with all three shapes.
Patterns are like songs for your eyes. See if your family can read your pattern out loud.

takeaway: Stamping the same shape in a row makes patterns that march across the page.
safetyNotes: An adult cuts the sponge into shapes; wash hands after painting.
screenFreeExtension: Stamp a pattern border around a drawing to make a picture frame.
